```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try html_to_markdown_rs.convert("<p>visible</p><div role=\"tabpanel\" hidden>tab two body</div><template><p>row template</p></template>", "{\"hidden_content\":\"All\"}");
```
